description: In front of you there’s a light purple bowl with a small white duck inside, and nearby are a clear square cup, a green leaf piece, a small wooden block, and a yellow toy. The left hand stays resting on the surface while the right hand moves in from the right toward the bowl, pinches and lifts the duck out as a right-hand object, then carries it to the right and lowers it into the clear square cup before releasing it.
